# RE-ACH.github.io<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>배달의민족 공식협력사</title>
<meta name="description" content="배달의민족 공식협력사 김현수. 광고 입점 및 업체 등록 문의. 010-6773-9283">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@300;400;500;700;900&family=Rajdhani:wght@700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --c:#2AC1BC;--cg:rgba(42,193,188,0.35);
  --bg:#06060a;--s:#0d0d14;--t:#f5f5f0;
  --m:rgba(245,245,240,0.45);--b:rgba(42,193,188,0.12);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--t);overflow-x:hidden}
::selection{background:var(--c);color:#000}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:20px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--c)}
#cv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}

/* NAV */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;padding:1rem 3rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(6,6,10,0.85);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--b)}
.nl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.nl img{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover}
.nl span{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--c)}
.nm{display:flex;gap:2rem}
.nm a{font-size:11px;color:var(--m);text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}
.nm a:hover{color:var(--c)}
.nc{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#000;background:var(--c);padding:10px 24px;border-radius:2px;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 0 24px var(--cg);transition:box-shadow .3s}
.nc:hover{box-shadow:0 0 50px var(--cg)}

/* HERO */
.hero{position:relative;z-index:1;min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:0 12vw;overflow:hidden}
.hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:62%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:700px;height:700px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(42,193,188,0.07) 0%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.he{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--c);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:2rem;opacity:0;justify-content:center}
.he::before{content:'';width:36px;height:1px;background:var(--c)}.he::after{content:'';width:36px;height:1px;background:var(--c)}
.ht{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,5rem);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-1px;margin-bottom:2.5rem;opacity:0}
.ht .a{color:var(--c);text-shadow:0 0 60px var(--cg),0 0 120px rgba(42,193,188,0.15)}
.ht .o{-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(245,245,240,0.25);color:transparent;letter-spacing:2px}
.ht .w{display:block;overflow:hidden}
.hs{font-size:clamp(13px,1.4vw,15px);color:var(--m);line-height:1.9;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto 3rem;opacity:0}
.hb{display:flex;gap:1rem;opacity:0;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.bm{padding:16px 44px;background:var(--c);color:#000;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 0 32px var(--cg);transition:all .3s}
.bm:hover{box-shadow:0 0 64px var(--cg);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.bgo{padding:16px 44px;background:transparent;color:var(--t);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--b);transition:all .3s}
.bgo:hover{border-color:var(--c);color:var(--c)}
.hscr{position:absolute;bottom:2.5rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;opacity:0}
.hscr span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:4px;color:var(--m);text-transform:uppercase}
.scl{width:1px;height:52px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--c),transparent);animation:sp 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sp{0%,100%{opacity:.3}50%{opacity:1}}

/* MARQUEE */
.mq{position:relative;z-index:1;border-top:1px solid var(--b);border-bottom:1px solid var(--b);padding:1.2rem 0;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(42,193,188,0.025)}
.mqi{display:flex;gap:3rem;white-space:nowrap;animation:mqs 22s linear infinite}
.mqi span{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--m)}
.mqi .dot{color:var(--c)}
@keyframes mqs{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* STATS */
.stbar{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-bottom:1px solid var(--b)}
.si{padding:3.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid var(--b)}
.si:last-child{border-right:none}
.snum{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.5vw,3rem);color:var(--c);letter-spacing:2px;text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--cg)}
.slbl{font-size:12px;color:var(--m);letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:6px;text-transform:uppercase}

/* SECTIONS */
section{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:9rem 10vw}
.secn{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--c);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.secn::after{content:'';height:1px;width:50px;background:var(--c)}
.sh{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.5vw,3.2rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.sh .dim{color:var(--m)}
.sd{font-size:14px;color:var(--m);line-height:1.9;max-width:480px;margin-bottom:4rem}

/* WHY */
.wg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--b)}
.wc{padding:3rem 2.5rem;background:var(--bg);transition:background .4s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.wc::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--c);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .5s}
.wc:hover{background:rgba(42,193,188,0.03)}
.wc:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.wn{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:3.5rem;color:rgba(42,193,188,0.07);line-height:1;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.wc h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.wc p{font-size:13px;color:var(--m);line-height:1.8}

/* PRODUCTS */
.psec{background:rgba(42,193,188,0.02);border-top:1px solid var(--b);border-bottom:1px solid var(--b)}
.pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.5rem}
.pc{border:1px solid var(--b);padding:2.5rem;background:var(--s);border-radius:4px;transition:border-color .4s}
.pc:hover{border-color:rgba(42,193,188,0.3)}
.pc.ft{border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 50px rgba(42,193,188,0.08),inset 0 0 50px rgba(42,193,188,0.02)}
.ptag{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c);margin-bottom:1rem}
.pn{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;letter-spacing:1px}
.pd{font-size:13px;color:var(--m);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:2rem}
.pfl{font-size:10px;color:var(--m);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.pfn{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:2rem;color:var(--c);text-shadow:0 0 20px var(--cg)}
.pdv{height:1px;background:var(--b);margin:1.5rem 0}
.plist{list-style:none}
.plist li{font-size:13px;color:var(--m);padding:6px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.plist li::before{content:'';width:3px;height:3px;background:var(--c);border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}

/* BENEFITS */
.bgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1.5rem}
.bc{padding:3rem;border:1px solid var(--b);background:var(--s);position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px}
.bc::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-30px;right:-30px;width:150px;height:150px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(42,193,188,0.07) 0%,transparent 70%)}
.bnum{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:3rem;color:var(--c);text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--cg);line-height:1;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.btit{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
.bdesc{font-size:13px;color:var(--m);line-height:1.7}

/* CARD SECTION */
.csec{background:rgba(42,193,188,0.015);border-top:1px solid var(--b)}
.clay{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5rem;align-items:center}
.ciwrap{position:relative}
.ciwrap::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-20px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(42,193,188,0.1) 0%,transparent 70%);z-index:0}
.cimg{position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;max-width:400px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(42,193,188,0.25);box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(42,193,188,0.15),0 0 120px rgba(42,193,188,0.06);display:block}
.cinfo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.5rem}
.ctag{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--c);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.ctag::before{content:'';width:36px;height:1px;background:var(--c)}
.cname{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.5rem);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:1px}
.cname .em{color:var(--c);text-shadow:0 0 40px var(--cg)}
.ccomp{font-size:13px;color:var(--m);letter-spacing:1px}
.crows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem;margin-top:.5rem}
.crow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:4px;background:var(--s);transition:border-color .3s}
.crow:hover{border-color:var(--c)}
.crowlbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--m);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:2px}
.crowval{font-size:14px;font-weight:700}

/* FAQ */
.flist{border:1px solid var(--b)}
.fitem{border-bottom:1px solid var(--b)}
.fitem:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.fq{padding:1.6rem 2rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;font-size:14px;background:var(--s);transition:all .3s}
.fq:hover{color:var(--c);background:rgba(42,193,188,0.03)}
.fqico{color:var(--c);font-size:22px;font-weight:300;line-height:1}
.fa{padding:1.5rem 2rem;font-size:13px;color:var(--m);line-height:1.9;background:rgba(42,193,188,0.02);border-top:1px solid var(--b);display:none}

/* CTA */
.cta{text-align:center;padding:12rem 10vw;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cta::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:800px;height:800px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(42,193,188,0.06) 0%,transparent 65%)}
.ctxt{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,6vw,6rem);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-1px;margin-bottom:2rem;position:relative}
.ctxt .g{color:var(--c);text-shadow:0 0 60px var(--cg),0 0 120px rgba(42,193,188,0.1)}
.csub{font-size:14px;color:var(--m);margin-bottom:2.5rem;letter-spacing:1px}
.cph{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.5vw,3rem);color:var(--c);letter-spacing:4px;text-decoration:none;display:block;margin-bottom:3rem;text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--cg);transition:text-shadow .3s}
.cph:hover{text-shadow:0 0 80px var(--cg)}
.cbtns{display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* FORM */
.fsec{background:var(--s);border-top:1px solid var(--b)}
.fbox{max-width:520px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--b);padding:3rem;border-radius:4px}
.ftit{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.8rem;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:2rem}
.fr{margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.fr label{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--m);margin-bottom:8px}
.fr input,.fr select,.fr textarea{width:100%;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--s);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:2px;color:var(--t);font-size:14px;font-family:inherit;outline:none;transition:border-color .3s}
.fr input:focus,.fr select:focus,.fr textarea:focus{border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,193,188,0.15)}
.fr select option{background:var(--s)}
.fr textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:100px}
.fck{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.fck input{width:auto;margin-top:4px;accent-color:var(--c)}
.fck label{font-size:12px;color:var(--m);line-height:1.6}
.fsub{width:100%;padding:16px;background:var(--c);color:#000;border:none;border-radius:2px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:box-shadow .3s;box-shadow:0 0 24px var(--cg)}
.fsub:hover{box-shadow:0 0 50px var(--cg)}
.flay{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5rem;align-items:start}
.fci h3{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:2.5rem}
.fcr{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:1.75rem}
.fcico{color:var(--c);font-size:20px;margin-top:2px}
.fclbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--m);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px}
.fcval{font-size:15px;font-weight:700}

/* FOOTER */
footer{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:2rem 3rem;border-top:1px solid var(--b);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem}
footer p{font-size:11px;color:var(--m);line-height:1.8}
footer a{color:var(--c);text-decoration:none}
.flogo{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;object-fit:cover}

/* FLOAT */
.float{position:fixed;bottom:2rem;right:2rem;z-index:99;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.fbtn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;transition:all .3s}
.fbcall{background:var(--c);color:#000;box-shadow:0 0 20px var(--cg)}
.fbcall:hover{box-shadow:0 0 40px var(--cg)}
.fbkakao{background:#FEE500;color:#111;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(254,229,0,.25)}

@media(max-width:768px){
  nav{padding:1rem 1.5rem}
  .nm{display:none}
  section{padding:5rem 6vw}
  .wg,.pg{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .bgrid,.flay,.clay{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .fci{display:none}
  .stbar{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .si{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--b)}
  .si:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .cta{padding:6rem 6vw}
  footer{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;padding:2rem}
  .float{bottom:1rem;right:1rem}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="cv"></canvas>

<nav>
  <div class="nl" style="align-items:center;gap:10px">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="배달의민족 로고" style="width:auto;height:36px;border-radius:0;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0">
    <span style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.3;gap:3px">
      <span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
        <span style="font-family:'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-0.5px;color:#f5f5f0">배달의민족</span>
        <span style="background:#2AC1BC;color:#000;font-family:'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 6px) 0,100% 50%,calc(100% - 6px) 100%,0 100%);letter-spacing:1px">공식협력사</span>
      </span>
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Mobile Solutions" style="height:10px;width:auto;display:block">
    </span>

  <div class="nm">

    <a href="#about">담당자</a>
    <a href="#contact">상담신청</a>
  </div>
  <a href="tel:010-6773-9283" class="nc">무료 상담</a>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero" id="home">
  <div class="he" id="he"><strong>배달의민족 공식 협력사</strong></div>
  <h1 class="ht" id="ht">
    <span class="w"><span class="a">배달 앱 1위</span></span>
    <span class="w">배달의 민족</span>

<!-- MARQUEE -->

    <span>입점부터 운영까지 무료컨설팅</span><span class="dot">✦</span>

    <span>무료 방문 상담</span><span class="dot">✦</span>
    <span>신규 프로모션 지원</span><span class="dot">✦</span>
    <span>24시간 상담 가능</span><span class="dot">✦</span>
    <span>입점부터 운영까지 무료컨설팅</span><span class="dot">✦</span>

</div>

<!-- STATS -->
<div class="stbar">
  <div class="si"><div class="snum"><strong>2,300만+</strong></div><div class="slbl">매 월 배달의민족 이용고객</div></div>
  <div class="si"><div class="snum"><strong>2.0~7.8%</strong></div><div class="slbl">매출 산정 후 상생요금제 적용 시 최저 2%</div></div>

</div>

<!-- WHY -->
<section id="why">
  <div class="secn">01 — manager</div>
  <h2 class="sh">배달의 민족 입점부터<br>관리까지 <span class="dim">책임집니다!</span></h2>
  <p class="sd">매장 관리도 바쁜데, 배민까지 혼자서 하시게요?</p>
  <div class="wg">

<script>
// THREE.JS 파티클 + 3D 오브젝트
const canvas=document.getElementById('cv');
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas,alpha:true,antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio,2));
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth,window.innerHeight);
const scene=new THREE.Scene();
const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60,window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight,0.1,1000);
camera.position.z=35;

// 파티클
const N=1500;
const pos=new Float32Array(N*3);
for(let i=0;i<N;i++){pos[i*3]=(Math.random()-.5)*100;pos[i*3+1]=(Math.random()-.5)*100;pos[i*3+2]=(Math.random()-.5)*60;}
const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
const pmat=new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:0x2AC1BC,size:.15,transparent:true,opacity:.6});
const pts=new THREE.Points(geo,pmat);
scene.add(pts);

// 메시 라인
const lmat=new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0x2AC1BC,transparent:true,opacity:.06});
for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
  const p=[];
  for(let j=0;j<6;j++)p.push(new THREE.Vector3((Math.random()-.5)*80,(Math.random()-.5)*80,(Math.random()-.5)*40));
  scene.add(new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(p),lmat));
}

// 3D 오브젝트 — 토러스 + 정이십면체
const wmat=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x2AC1BC,wireframe:true,transparent:true,opacity:.05});
const t1=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(12,3,8,24),wmat);
t1.position.set(20,5,-10);scene.add(t1);
const t2=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(7,2,6,18),wmat);
t2.position.set(-25,-8,-15);scene.add(t2);
const ico=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(6,1),wmat);
ico.position.set(15,-15,-5);scene.add(ico);
const t3=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(5,1.5,6,16),wmat);
t3.position.set(-10,18,-20);scene.add(t3);

let mx=0,my=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=(e.clientX/window.innerWidth-.5)*.4;my=(e.clientY/window.innerHeight-.5)*.4});

function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  pts.rotation.y+=.0006;pts.rotation.x+=.0002;
  t1.rotation.x+=.003;t1.rotation.y+=.005;
  t2.rotation.x-=.004;t2.rotation.z+=.003;
  ico.rotation.y+=.006;ico.rotation.x+=.004;
  t3.rotation.z+=.005;t3.rotation.x+=.002;
  camera.position.x+=(mx-camera.position.x)*.04;
  camera.position.y+=(-my-camera.position.y)*.04;
  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
animate();

window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{
  camera.aspect=window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth,window.innerHeight);
});

// GSAP ScrollTrigger
gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
gsap.to('#he',{opacity:1,y:0,duration:1,delay:.4,ease:'power3.out'});gsap.from('#he',{y:25});
gsap.to('#ht',{opacity:1,y:0,duration:1.3,delay:.7,ease:'power3.out'});gsap.from('#ht',{y:50});
gsap.to('#hs',{opacity:1,y:0,duration:1,delay:1.1,ease:'power3.out'});gsap.from('#hs',{y:25});
gsap.to('#hb',{opacity:1,y:0,duration:1,delay:1.4,ease:'power3.out'});gsap.from('#hb',{y:20});
gsap.to('#hscr',{opacity:1,duration:1,delay:2.2,ease:'power3.out'});

gsap.utils.toArray('.wc').forEach((el,i)=>{
  gsap.from(el,{opacity:0,y:50,duration:.9,delay:i*.08,ease:'power3.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:el,start:'top 88%'}});
});
gsap.utils.toArray('.pc').forEach((el,i)=>{
  gsap.from(el,{opacity:0,y:50,duration:.9,delay:i*.12,ease:'power3.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:el,start:'top 88%'}});
});
gsap.utils.toArray('.bc').forEach((el,i)=>{
  gsap.from(el,{opacity:0,y:40,duration:.8,delay:i*.1,ease:'power3.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:el,start:'top 88%'}});
});
gsap.utils.toArray('.si').forEach((el,i)=>{
  gsap.from(el,{opacity:0,y:30,duration:.8,delay:i*.15,ease:'power3.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:el,start:'top 90%'}});
});
gsap.from('.cimg',{opacity:0,x:-60,duration:1.2,ease:'power3.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:'.clay',start:'top 80%'}});
gsap.from('.cinfo',{opacity:0,x:60,duration:1.2,ease:'power3.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:'.clay',start:'top 80%'}});

// FAQ 토글
document.querySelectorAll('.fq').forEach(q=>{
  q.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const a=q.nextElementSibling,ic=q.querySelector('.fqico');
    const open=a.style.display==='block';
    document.querySelectorAll('.fa').forEach(e=>e.style.display='none');
    document.querySelectorAll('.fqico').forEach(e=>e.textContent='+');
    if(!open){a.style.display='block';ic.textContent='−';}
  });
});
</script>
